newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: KNP BT to buy Belgian packaging maker.
newsitem.headline: KNP BT to buy Belgian packaging maker.

text.p: Dutch paper and office equipment group KNP BT said on Wednesday it had agreed in principle to buy Van Mierlo Proost, a Belgian manufacturer of printed corrugated cardboard packaging.
KNP BT said that prior to its takeover of Van Mierlo Proost some 70 of the Belgian company's 210 jobs would be axed to make it more profitable.

"This staff reduction, together with the expected synergies generated by the integration of the company within KNP BT Packaging, will contribute to a speedy recovery of Van Mierlo Proost's profitability," KNP BT said in a statement.

The acquisition of Van Mierlo Proost, which generates annual turnover of some 60 million guilders ($34.1 million), fitted with KNP BT's strategy of bolstering its position in corrugated cardboard packaging, it said. ($ = 1.758 Dutch Guilders)
